authorization: T106 prerequisite utility criterion approved before T105 results
scenarios: All eight predeclared T105 evaluation families, equally weighted
checkpoint_selection: Fixed final checkpoint for every seed; no best-seed selection
comparator: The same family and policy seed's initial checkpoint on the identical eight scenarios

uncertainty.method: All 27 length-three resamples with replacement of the three paired per-seed success gains
uncertainty.interval: Linearly interpolated 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles of the sorted 27 means

selection_rule: The first whole candidate family in declared priority order satisfying every requirement may satisfy the mechanical per-rig utility prerequisite
missing_or_failed_evidence: Prerequisite remains closed; do not omit rows, relax thresholds, add seeds or extend training
scope_limits: This prerequisite does not change the T105 improvement-over-authored-controller decision
A passing prerequisite does not establish owner feel approval or morphology transfer
Additional actor profiles must independently be accepted before a morphology experiment
A later morphology experiment needs its own fixed split, capability matching and budget declaration
Absent host morphology and arbitrary geometric perturbation controls remain unavailable rather than simulated
